object_description: single continuous cylindrical volume enclosing a generous circular courtyard
design_condition: the pure circular geometry gathers the whole programme in one continuous form around a central courtyard, entered from two strategic points with intermediate passages keeping the volume permeable to its surroundings

positive: The clear, unambiguous urban planning solution convinced the jury against a complex backdrop
The pure geometry of the outer cylinder provides a serene foundation for the new quarter
The perfect curvature elegantly avoids the problem of an overly imposing single front
The volumetric clarity of the perfect circle is also found inside the volume
A generous courtyard provides a central common space visible from all sides
The courtyard is both meeting place and playground, the arena of the new district
Access from two main strategic points is obvious
Intermediate passages guarantee the permeability of the volume with its environment
The circular geometry is convincingly reflected in the interior organisation
The ramp forming all the floors develops a continuous surface on a barely perceptible slope
Generous distribution spaces combine interior circulation with covered outdoor areas
These are either shared with the courtyard or private towards the exterior
The promise of living together differs from common apartment typologies
A committed, innovative and coherent architectural proposal
The project suggests the new district will be a unique place with a strong identity
The jury is convinced the economic target is feasible without altering the project
negative: The functions and empty spaces on the ground floor still need in-depth study to balance open and closed areas
Optimisation is needed between the common and private parts of the exterior ramp surfaces
The unitary nature of the building prohibits segregation between the two resident groups
This can lead to cohabitation problems due to different schedules and lifestyles
The project marginally deviates from the specifications and must be corrected to comply
The construction system and energy concept must be optimised within the economic target
